mutation_summary.note: Reflects MUTATION_HARDENING_STATUS.md's per-file accounting as of this commit -- the authoritative source, with exact survivor IDs, equivalence proofs, and fix commits for every entry. This JSON separates three distinct states per file, per the release checklist's requirement not to claim a flattering aggregate that conflates them: (1) killed/survived as-run -- the literal last real mutmut-tool result (local or CI, see verified_by), unmodified by any fix written afterward; (2) fixes_pending_reverification -- survivor IDs this session wrote a fix for and verified independently (direct mutant simulation, or targeted pytest runs against a manually-applied mutant), but has NOT yet re-run through the mutation tool itself to confirm the kill; (3) accepted_survivors -- IDs confirmed equivalent or explicitly accepted as defensive/unreachable, with documented reasoning, not gaps. No full CI-run re-verification of the complete 20-file matrix against this exact commit has been executed -- mutation.yml was repaired this pass (added a missing cosmic-ray baseline step, fixed a gate-check silent-pass bug, fixed shard-identity and nested-path bugs) and a fresh sweep is expected post-push, per this release's explicit instruction not to trigger mutation CI before that point.
